title: Software Development Engineer, ASA
description:
**Description**
Retail Business Services (RBS) supports Amazon’s Retail business growth WW through three core tasks. These are (a) Selection, where RBS sources, creates and enrich ASINs to drive GMS growth; (b) Defect Elimination: where RBS resolves inbound supply chain defects and develops root cause fixes to improve free cash flow and (c) supports operational process for WW Retail teams where there is an air gap in the tech stack. The tech team in RBS develops automation that leverages Machine/Deep Learning to scale execution of these high complex tasks that currently require human cognitive skills. Our solutions ensure that information in Amazon's catalog is complete, correct and, comprehensive enough to give Amazon customers a great shopping experience every time. We are building solutions to move towards retail automation and are using latest technology like LLM to solve business problems.
  
  
We believe in “Work Hard. Have Fun. Make History” value by having a strong focus on sharing learning experiences from the front line with the development teams. So, the options for people in the team are vast. If you like mastering a domain and going deep, we need you. If you can juggle three tasks and coordinate with multiple people in the heat of an incident, we need you. If you love the benefits of process and methodical improvement, you will love it here. If you want to keep your head down, headphones on, and bash out code to support the team, we have a spot for you too.
  
  
At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world’s most beloved brands – customer obsession is part of our company DNA.
  
  
We are seeking a Software Development Engineer who can design and develop systems for its businesses. As an SDE, you would have immense opportunity to explore avenues of how to model things, figure out right abstraction level, take judgement calls around multiple design trade offs at hand that influence a multi billion dollar business.
  
  
We are looking for highly talented software development engineers who are passionate not only about architecting and developing large scale distributed technology solutions but also innovating new ideas and providing directions to our business. You will get to work on some of the key initiatives planned to support our rapid evolution and growth of our businesses. In this process you will drive best practices, mentor other engineers, drive continuous improvements in engineering and operational excellence. You will use technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first-hand. The challenges SDEs solve for at Amazon are big and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. As a SDE with RBS team, you will work with talented peers of SDEs and Applied scientists to build robust engineering platforms to solve high impact issues. You will constantly stretch the boundaries of innovation to tackle the business challenges.
  
  
If you enjoy designing and building highly distributed systems that can scale and solving challenging problems, come to join us!
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
RBS Tech team puts a high value on work-life harmony. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and we encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring, detailed and constructive code reviews. We have casual coffee chats with Principal & Senior Engineers from RBS tech. You get an opportunity to network and have technical conversations around your work, technical challenges, suggestions, ideas and proposals. You can also seek advice and discuss about things outside work, like, life in general, your family, hobbies etc. We provide trainings to the employees through online learning platforms such as O'reilly and also encourage them to take up AWS/ML certifications.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Software developer with a diverse skillset and background. As a SDE-2, your work is consistently of high quality. You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them (and when it is not). You limit the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You make appropriate trade-offs, re-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., system hardware, database, memory/CPU, etc.). You work on project ideas with customers, stakeholders, and peers. You help your team evolve by actively participating in the code review process, design discussions, team planning, and ticket/metric reviews. You focus on operational excellence, constructively identifying problems and proposing solutions. You work on software enhancements that improve team software and processes. You are able to train new members on how team’s software is constructed, how it operates, how secure it is, and how it fits into the bigger picture.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

description:
**Description**
We are the guardians of the Amazon galaxy. The Account Compliance team strives to ensure that Amazon remains compliant and the cost of being compliant is never the reason where the business or our sellers cannot scale. Our diverse team innovates on behalf of their customers to build a trusted marketplace through best-in-class compliance products. With hundreds of millions of customers around the world depending on our products & services, our systems form the tip of the spear against bad actors. These actors might abuse Amazon products and undermine customer faith, so our success comes from identifying & removing them while delivering best-in-class customer experiences for the good actors and strategic customers. We’re creating the most trusted store on earth, enabling Amazon to innovate at scale, and supporting our customers to launch & grow their business faster than anywhere else in the world.

The software is smarter than the smartest bad actors in the world to protect the store from illegal activities at scale. Amazon's scale means that you'll be designing and developing custom distributed systems more advanced than those used in standard industry practices. These data-centric systems need to detect patterns across Amazon's huge customer population as they happen and be adaptive so that they can detect new modus operandi as they develop. Lastly, they need to be highly available, low latency, high quality systems. If this sounds interesting to you, then apply and find out more!

****Job Summary****
We are seeking a Principal Software Engineer to lead the technical direction of major programs in our connectors framework. In this role, you will bring simple solutions to complex, ambiguous problems: multi-tenant data ingestion at scale, read and write paths that never corrupt customer access data, and a connector contract that lets new integrations ship as configuration instead of code. You will act as technical lead for the engineers on your programs, advocate for architecture changes based on the product roadmap, and start making the people around you great.
  
  
****What You’ll Do****

* Own Large, Cross-Functional Programs: Lead large framework programs that need several engineers and teams to complete. Examples include moving on-premises connectivity to a cloud-managed agent with dual-run reconciliation and safe cutover, or extracting the integrations code into an independently deployable service.
* Design Across the Product: Design framework capabilities that span the product, such as the connector contract and the fulfillment path that routes provisioning and just-in-time elevate and revoke operations. Lead planning for those features with PM and partner teams.
* Advocate for Architecture Change: Propose and drive changes to the framework architecture based on business context and the product roadmap, such as moving more connectors from code to declarative configuration.
* Solve Hard Problems Simply: Bring simple designs to complex problems, including accurate ingestion at scale, deletion detection and mass-delete safeguards, and fair scheduling across tenants under target rate limits.
* Act as Technical Lead: Decide methods and procedures for new work, coordinate the engineers on your programs, and lead code reviews with the authority to approve product changes.
* Enhance Tools and Processes: Improve the development tools, AI-assisted workflows, and common automation modules that every connector engineer relies on. Set the standard for verifying AI-generated code and configuration.
* Raise Product Quality: Drive initiatives that improve framework quality, including test coverage, release processes, and defensive coding for edge cases, limits, and authorization paths.
* Represent Engineering: Serve as the engineering representative on escalated support issues and in design meetings with other teams. Drive root cause analysis (RCA) on production incidents and fixes that prevent whole classes of failures.
* Make Others Great: Mentor engineers at lower levels, give tech talks that other teams seek out, and take an active part in interviews.

**Nice to Have**

* Identity & Access Security Domain: Direct experience with IAM, PAM, IGA, or Secrets Management platforms. Familiarity with SCIM, entitlement modeling, or Zero Standing Privileges.
* Workflow & Job Orchestration: Experience with distributed job schedulers, queues, or durable workflow engines, such as Agenda, SQS, Kafka, or Temporal.
* Declarative Integration Frameworks: Experience building or extending low-code or no-code integration platforms, or transformation languages such as JSONata or JSONPath.
* Hybrid Connectivity: Experience designing agents or gateways that run inside customer networks and connect securely back to a cloud control plane.
* Service Decomposition & Delivery: Experience extracting services from a monolith, infrastructure as code with AWS CDK, progressive delivery, and feature flagging.
* Context Engineering & Retrieval: Experience structuring codebase documentation and architecture for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and reusable prompt templating.

**Impact**
As a Principal Software Engineer on the connectors framework, you will be a subject matter expert whose designs shape the whole integration platform. Every access review, lifecycle action, and just-in-time grant depends on the programs you lead. Your impact will be measured by the accuracy and reliability of the identity data we ingest, the success of the cross-team programs you deliver, and the growth of the engineers you lead.
  
  
****Qualifications****

* Backend Mastery: Deep hands-on experience building enterprise-grade services with Node.js, TypeScript, Express.js, and MongoDB.
* Cloud Infrastructure Leadership: Proven track record architecting, deploying, and operating scalable, multi-tenant solutions on AWS.
* Data Ingestion & Distributed Systems: Strong foundation in large-scale sync or ETL pipelines, including idempotency, consistency, checkpointing, rate limiting, and failure recovery.
* Integration Protocols: Practical experience with REST, SCIM 2.0, GraphQL, and SOAP APIs, plus OAuth 2.0 and other enterprise authentication schemes.
* Technical Leadership: Experience acting as technical lead on large projects, coordinating several engineers, and approving designs and code.
* AI Tooling & Output Verification: Expertise in prompt and context engineering, and in setting review standards that verify AI output for correctness and security.
* System Design & Extensibility: Strong foundation in designing clean APIs and SDKs, refactoring complex code bases, and making explicit architectural trade-offs for long-term scalability.
* Production & Operational Ownership: Extensive experience debugging complex production services, driving RCAs, and putting systemic prevention in place.
* Cross-Functional Influence: Skilled at influencing PM, Design, and engineering peers on other teams, writing clear RFCs, and presenting complex ideas clearly.

****Qualifications****
**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

Bitwarden promotes better internet security and safety with the leading open source password management solution for individuals, teams, and business organizations. As a Tech Lead for our Web Platform team, you will be responsible for leading the technical direction and supporting the engineering effort of a team focused on building and maintaining the core web application tooling and client services that support all of our web-based clients. This includes our web application, Electron-based desktop client, browser extension, and CLI, as well as other clients and additional Products in the future. You will be expected to own and understand the entirety of the team’s domain, and be able to support the other engineers on the team as well as engage in well-reasoned discussions with other technical leaders in the organization.
  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Update and maintain Bitwarden's web monorepo tooling, including our nx monorepo packaging infrastructure, our webpack build pipelines, and our npm package management systems.
* Drive repo-wide modernization initiatives, such as migrating to Vite and pnpm or adopting nx, including any coordination with other teams within the organization.
* Work closely with your manager to maintain the technical roadmap for the team, ensuring that core platform dependencies are up to date and emerging technologies are considered for potential adoption.
* Unblock and support other engineers on the team.
* Collaborate with other Tech Leads to ensure that cross-team technical direction is aligned when initiatives span team boundaries.
* Serve as a representative of the team in technical discussions and be able to speak authoritatively about your domain.
* Set the example for thorough code reviews, using them to spread knowledge on the team and ensure high standards for code quality.
* Occasionally review & approve bug fixes submitted by the user community

**WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN**

* 8-10 years of expertise in modern web application build and packaging pipelines, including strong demonstrated experience with managing and updating nx, webpack, Vite, npm, and pnpm.
* Deep system design expertise: you can architect scalable, secure and maintainable systems, evaluate trade-offs across components and services, and guide teams toward sound technical decisions.
* Extensive experience with cross-platform web application development - understanding how to work within and support Electron environments and browser extensions and the limitations and nuances of their APIs.
* A bias for long-horizon thinking, ensuring that decisions made today build stable and maintainable tooling for the future.
* Experience on a Platform team, where other teams are your customers, and you are responsible for ensuring that their feature development can be done with tooling as a support and not a hindrance.
* Experience using AI tooling in your development and testing workflow (Anthropic Claude preferred)
* Collaborative and adaptable mindset
* Openness and authenticity combined with excellent communication skills
* Excitement and enthusiasm for open source and for better internet security
* Excellent problem-solving skills – you might not know all the answers, but you know how to find and communicate the solution

* Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.
* Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software.
* We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world.
* Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team, and join our #growth-club to continue personal and professional development.
* At Bitwarden, we are passionate about what we do, but not necessarily everything we do. Our engineering team makes it a policy to carve out some time for personal growth, learning, skill building and pursuing personal passions that positively impact the team and company. To ensure that everyone has time to reaffirm their purpose and grow, you are encouraged to self-direct up to 15% of your week to what you feel is important for the company and for yourself.

The Principal Engineer builds and runs GSK's voice and unified communications platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within that platform, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil.
  
  
This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, working across voice and unified communications to integrate and assure delivery as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.

* Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes.
* Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work.
* Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed.
* Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.
* Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.

* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).

* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Minimum Level Of Job-Related Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 6-8 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud and hosting, network or digital workplace.
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.
* Extensive experience engineering enterprise voice and unified communications services.
* Strong knowledge of Session Initiation Protocol, call routing, session border controllers, quality of service and high availability.
* Evidence of improving voice quality, resilience, provisioning or operational support.

**Desirable Requirements**

* Professional level unified communications certification, such as CCNP Collaboration or Microsoft Teams Voice Engineer.
* Experience with cloud calling, contact centre or emergency calling services.
* Experience automating voice provisioning, monitoring or service assurance.

**Skills/Background**

* Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.
* Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.
* Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.
* Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.
* Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.
* Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.
